children: Revenue for the three months to September 26 came in at £439m with retail sales up 6% to £331m. The company expects adjusted pre-tax earnings of £52.8m-£56.0m according to its own compiled consensus of analysts’ forecasts.
“Customer growth continues to drive strong overall volume increases, with mild price inflation starting to come through after a sustained period of deflation,” Wickes said in a trading update.
“Further market outperformance has led to continued market share growth, with notable strength in timber, flooring, roofing and garden.”
Reporting by Frank Prenesti for Sharecast.com
